summary: Negative options.page yields negative start index and unexpected trailing slice.

findings.summary: Negative options.page yields negative startIndex resulting in backwards array slice
findings.rationale: Passing options.page = -1 parses to -1, evaluating truthy and bypassing the '|| 1' fallback. This sets startIndex to -20, causing slice(-20, -10) to extract trailing elements from the end of the collection rather than defaulting to page 1.
